title: Man Gets Busted With Stash Of Guns Outside Trump Rally
description:
► Code Blue Cam Merch 
http://www.codebluecam.com/

On August 28, 2024, police were called to investigate suspicious bags discovered near an event center in La Crosse, WI, just a day before a scheduled rally by former President Donald Trump. The bags had been hidden in bushes outside the building and the person who found them initially thought little of them. However, upon examining the bags, the individual uncovered something deeply concerning.

Our featured content aims to depict law enforcement interactions, emphasizing education over public shaming or ridicule. In a world filled with misleading conversations about law enforcement, it's crucial to present these interactions within their contexts to inform and educate the public.
